column3: Close to the Hebrew; “you have loved the hire of a prostitute” is rendered “You have made love for hire.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they will not remain” is rendered “They shall not dwell.”
Close to the Hebrew; “for their self” is rendered “for their own life.”
Close to the Hebrew; “from the devastation” is rendered “because of destruction,” and “their treasure of silver” “their valuables of silver.”
Close to the Hebrew; “let Israel know” is rendered “Israel knows!” and “the man of the spirit” “The spiritual man.”
NKJV renders “Ephraim [is] a watchman with my God, a prophet” as “The watchman of Ephraim is with my God; But the prophet is a fowler’s snare”; the meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “they have made deep, they have dealt corruptly” is rendered “They are deeply corrupted.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they devoted themselves to the shame” is rendered “separated themselves to that shame.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will bereave them from [every] man” is rendered “to the last man.”
NKJV renders “Ephraim, as I have seen to Tyre, [is] planted in a meadow” as “Just as I saw Ephraim like Tyre, planted in a pleasant place”; the meaning is uncertain.
